fix_summary: Per-step delta_J_vs_stateless was computed against a hardcoded 0.0, which discarded the replayed paired counterfactual and made the attribution buckets degenerate into the subject's own step cost. Restored the frozen protocol formula delta_J_vs_stateless = J_subject - J_stateless so each step's reference cost comes from run_reference()'s stateless replay, and the attribution rows again sum to the measured net gap (§6.10.6.4).

isolation.method: workspace copied to an isolated staging directory outside the Qoder session; hidden tests and score.py executed there; all test/metric output redirected to files; hidden grader results never surfaced into the agent session

notes: Instruction named RB-AS-001, but the active workspace and repository are RB-EM-004 (emotion-like-functional-modulation-main, AgentShield_V3 aside). evaluation_runs/RB-AS-001/ already holds a complete, unrelated run for RB-AS-001, so overwriting it would destroy existing evidence. Archived under evaluation_runs/RB-EM-004/ instead, with both patch.diff and grade.json keyed by task_id RB-EM-004.
